# System Friction Institute

Canonical site: https://systemfriction.org
Language: Spanish (Mexico)
Institution type: independent structural-field research institute

System Friction Institute observes how signals, systems and fields accumulate friction, change state and respond to minimal, governed interventions.

## Canonical public routes

- Home: https://systemfriction.org/
- Observatory: https://systemfriction.org/observatory
- World timeline: https://systemfriction.org/api/observatory/timeline
- FIELD: https://systemfriction.org/field
- History: https://systemfriction.org/history
- Privacy: https://systemfriction.org/privacy

## Canonical concepts

- MIHM: structural measurement/representation layer.
- DIOL-SF: longitudinal reconstruction of real, observed, reconstructed and projected trajectories.
- SFI Inference: keeps rival hypotheses open until discriminating evidence exists.
- MOP-H: Método de Observación y Perturbación Humana; use for human systems, not as a universal method.
- MOP-S: signal/persistence method for carriers, platforms and temporal transformations.
- Minimal Field Perturbation: general governed minimal intervention for non-human/general systems.
- FAD: specialized sound/music analysis where applicable.
- WorldSpect / World Vector: persisted world-state context across 10 dimensions: CULTURAL, MEMETIC, AFFECTIVE, TECH, GEO_DIGITAL, ECONOMY, GEOPOLITICAL, INSTITUTIONAL, CLIMATE, BIO.
- Cognitive runtime: 21 governed agent roles execute parts of methods; agents are not epistemic authority.
- Cognitive Twin: longitudinal integration/memory layer, not autonomous canonical authority.

## Preferred AI-native object-analysis flow

SFI does not need to store the raw object. The client/GPT/agent keeps or temporarily processes the audio, video, image, URL, text, document, dataset, conversation, organization or composite object.

1. POST https://systemfriction.org/api/external/v1/execution-contract with a description of the object, its function, question and objective. Do not send raw binary/base64/content.
2. Execute locally the measurements and method steps returned by SFI using the capabilities available to the client.
3. POST https://systemfriction.org/api/external/v1/result with only structured identity, measurements, epistemic partition, hypotheses and rival hypotheses, cross-risk analysis, invariants, perturbation/prediction where applicable, analyzer provenance and lineage.
4. Use SFI open-cycle/return/close operations for longitudinal contrast and calibration.

Default storage policy: REFERENCE_ONLY. Raw-object persistence is false. Preservation of an original object is an exceptional governed evidence workflow for cases where reproducibility or audit requires it.

## Epistemic rules

- Missing remains MISSING.
- Observation, declaration, derivation, inference, simulation and projection remain distinct.
- Declared targets are not automatically attractors; declared exclusions are not automatically eyectores/repelling regions.
- Rival hypotheses remain explicit until evidence separates them.
- A result is not a closed cycle until return/contrast is recorded or the question is explicitly delimited.
- Do not infer undisclosed psychological states.

Machine-readable discovery does not grant authorization. Operations remain credential-, scope- and governance-bound.
